# CONF-002: Requests missing required _meta fields are rejected with -32602

| Severity | Applies to | Spec section |
|---|---|---|
| error | modern era, stdio, http | [2026-07-28/basic/index#meta](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/basic/index#meta) |

Sends server/discover once without io.modelcontextprotocol/protocolVersion (stdio only) and once without io.modelcontextprotocol/clientCapabilities. A request missing a required field is malformed and MUST be rejected with -32602 Invalid params; on HTTP with status 400. Over HTTP the missing-version case is skipped, because the body then also disagrees with the required MCP-Protocol-Version header, for which -32020 is equally required.

From the command line: `mcpprobe checks explain CONF-002`. To leave it out of a run, add `"CONF-002"` to `[checks] disable` in [mcpprobe.toml](../configuration.md); to change how much it counts, use `severity_overrides`.
